sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 41 = check 40; Internal Quality Checks row 41, no annotation in column E for check 40; neighbouring annotations on checks 41 and 42 read)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (file list; scoring.toml and score.py policy compared by reading the task copies)
evidence:
STRUCTURE (read, supports a graded reward; no design defect found). tests/scoring.toml:1-11 gives zero-weight gates, weights 0.6/0.2/0.2 and a functional floor of 0.05; tests/tools/score.py:46-48 returns the weighted mean once gates and floor pass. Functional is 42 binary criteria, weights 1.0/1.5/2.0, sum 58.5, aggregation weighted_mean (scored/functional/judge.toml:20-21), so one criterion moves the reward by 0.010-0.021; polish is 6 binary criteria (0.033 each); visual is 3 likert criteria with 0-5 anchors. The floor is cleared by about three functional criteria (>2.925 of 58.5). Criteria do not all hang on one precondition: by my classification 19 editor criteria (weight 24.5, 42%) need neither Run nor Save, 16 need a working Run (23.0, 39%), 7 need Save/library (11.0, 19%). tests/app_context.md:29 says 'Run may be broken in a submitted app. Criteria that do not depend on Run are still scored on their own steps', cw_long_line_editing says 'Running the draft is not part of this criterion' (functional/judge.toml:92), cw_same_line_carets says 'Undo behaviour is not judged here' (functional/judge.toml:119), and the prompt requires independent scoring and continuing after failure (functional/prompt.md:10-11). The render gate now needs only load, type one word and reload: 'Do not press Run, do not save anything' (gates/render/judge.toml:23). Smaller shared preconditions are bounded: an editor with no undo at all loses about 19.5/58.5 functional weight plus three polish criteria; an app with no live library push loses 5.0/58.5 (cw_live_library_update, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft); no conflict detection loses 3.0/58.5. These narrow the spread but do not collapse it.

MEASUREMENT (missing for these bytes). raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'No configured judge run exists for these bytes'. The only configured-judge results are on an EARLIER candidate and they are exactly all-or-nothing: Oracle reward 0.9833, nop 0, and GPT-5.6 Luna reward 0.0 with render 0.0, constraints 1.0, gates_passed 0 and the scored suite skipped (verifier/reward.json of run 6e537d14). So the one observed non-golden submission produced no graded signal. The current bytes change the render gate to remove the Run dependency, which on reading should let that class of app reach the scored suite and earn up to 35.5/58.5 functional, but this has not been run. The index holds no mutated weak-app or partial-app run, and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:31 requires a separate hash-bound runtime record for reward discrimination before local clearance. Scripted golden checks (3 gate, 42 functional, 6 polish) show only the top of the scale. Per SKILL.md:57 an unmeasured claim is not upgraded to Pass.
counterexample: Not a demonstrated failure. Probes considered: (a) broken app that might pass - an app whose Run never works (the Luna pattern) can no longer be zeroed by the render gate as written, and is limited to at most 35.5/58.5 functional; whether the judge really scores the 26 Run-independent criteria on such an app instead of failing them wholesale is unmeasured. (b) conforming alternative that might fail - a strong editor and runtime whose Save is broken is zeroed by cw_shared_saved_record in the constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:31-32) despite roughly 47.5/58.5 of functional weight being reachable; this is a deliberate hard requirement under the review policy's gate rule, so I record it as a bounded loss of spread, not a defect.
suggested_fix: No task edit is indicated by this row. Before clearance, add a hash-bound discrimination record on these exact bytes: run the full configured judge (tests/test.sh in the verifier image) on at least two mutated weak apps, for example the golden with Run disabled and the golden with undo/redo or live library updates removed, and confirm the rewards land strictly between 0 and the Oracle score and in the expected order. Coordinate the runs with the owner; provider spend needs user authorization.
